channel.title: Governance Digest: ens
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: [RFC] NSEC Proofs as a Permissionless Release Trigger for TLDs (ens)
item.description: An RFC proposes letting anyone return a claimed TLD to DAO custody by submitting a DNSSEC NSEC proof that its delegation has been removed from the DNS root.

item.title: [7.5] [Social] IPS Amendment No. 2: IPS Amendment Authority (ens)
item.description: ENS voters decide whether the ENS Foundation Board, not a DAO vote, may amend the Endowment investment policy, replacing the Meta-Governance Working Group as oversight body.

item.title: [7.4] [Social] IPS Amendment No. 1: Endowment Options Overlay (ens)
item.description: ENS voters decide whether the Endowment may write covered options as part of its scheduled ETH and stablecoin rebalancing, within written limits.

item.title: ENS DAO Newsletter #124 - 11/15/2026 (ens)
item.description: Weekly ENS DAO newsletter: two social proposals on the endowment policy and two executable proposals (a roughly 200k USDC working-group funding request and a DNSSEC upgrade) are in discussion, plus the October endowment report.

item.title: ENS DAO Newsletter #123 - 11/1/2026 (ens)
item.description: ENS newsletter lists ENSv2 activation as executed, a Meta-Governance Working Group Term 7 funding request of 201,559 USDC as passed, and new draft IPS amendments and ENSv2 pricing temp checks.

item.title: Notice of amendment to Bylaw 16 (annual and interim budgets) (ens)
item.description: The ENS Foundation Board amended Bylaw 16 to set an annual budget deadline and allow a capped interim budget; no tokenholder vote is required and it takes effect 7 November 2026.

item.title: ENS-budget: budget-first ENS v2 renewals for viem (ens)
item.description: A community developer announced ens-budget, a small TypeScript library for ENS v2 renewals that finds the longest renewal a stablecoin budget buys.

item.title: [7.3] [Social] Governor Nexus Update (ens)
item.description: ENS is voting on approving Governor Nexus, a new version of its governor contract, which would go through an external audit funded by MetaGov before any migration proposal.

item.title: [Draft] [Social] IPS Amendment No. 2: IPS Amendment Authority (ens)
item.description: Draft social proposal would let the ENS Foundation Board amend the Endowment's Investment Policy Statement and replace MetaGov as oversight body, while the DAO keeps control of the Minimum Runway and the amendment process.

item.title: [Social] [7.3] Select OpenZeppelin to audit Governor Nexus (ens)
item.description: ENS is voting on hiring OpenZeppelin to audit Governor Nexus, its new governance contracts, before any deployment. The audit is paid from an existing working-group budget, with no new DAO funding.
